## Steps to customize prompt tone:
#### 1. The customer first creates the WAV format prompt sound that needs to be customized.
Prompt sounds in WAV format can be produced through audio tool recording and other methods. The requirements for producing prompt sound files are as follows:
`Audio format: WAV format`
`Sampling rate: 8000Hz`
`Bitrate: 16 bits`
`Channel: Single Channel`
`File size: ≤128K`
`File name: refer to the following prompt content list "File name"`

###### Prompt content list:

| Function description  | Broadcast content | File name |
| ------------ | ------------ | ------------ | ---------- -- |
| Firmware upgrade  | upgrade successful and will be restarted | UpgradeOk.wav |
| AI algorithm or configuration file import  | The import file is complete | ImportOk.wav |
|Gsensor calibration  | alibration complete | CalibrationDone.wav|
| BSD right blind spot level 3 | Notice blind spots | BsdAlarm.wav |
|BSD Right Blind Spot Level 2  | Be Careful, Notice blind spots | BsdMiddleAlarm.wav |
| BSD right blind spot level 1 | Danger, Notice blind spots | BsdHighAlarm.wav |
|ADAS Lane Departure (the three prompt files broadcast the same content "Departure from the driving lane, please correct in time". The software level distinguishes the left and right deviations and uses different files) | Lane departure, please correct | LaneShift. wav LeftLaneShift.wav RightLaneShift.wav |
| ADAS inter-vehicle distance  | Please keep the distance | Range.wav |
|ADAS front vehicle collision | Collision risk | Danger.wav |
|~~ADAS pedestrian detection (not used)~~ |~~Notice pedestrians~~ | ~~Danger.wav~~ |
|~~ADAS crosswalk (not in use)~~  |~~Please notice the crosswalk~~ | ~~Discern.wav~~ |
| DSM smoking test  | Not smoking | Smoking.wav |
| DSM uses mobile phone detection (the two prompt files broadcast the same content "Do not use mobile phone". The software level distinguishes between making phone calls and playing with mobile phones and using different files | Do not make phone | Phoneing.wav DontUsePhone.wav |
|DSM fatigue detection | No fatigue driving | Fatigue.wav |
|DSM Distraction Detection | No distraction | Distraction.wav |
| DSM camera shield  | Do not block the lens | CameraShelter.wav |
| DSM face detection | Recognition failed. Please face the camera | NoFaceFound.wav |
| DSM Seat Belt Test | Please fasten your seat belt | Belt.wav |
| ~~DSM steering wheel detection (not used)~~ | ~~Do not leave the steering wheel~~ | ~~HoldWheel.wav~~ |
| DSM driver face detection (the second and third prompt files broadcast the same content, "Recognition failed, please try again." The software level distinguishes face detection recognition and face detection errors and uses different files) | Successful identification, good journey; Identification failed, please try again | FaceMatching.wav FaceMatchingFail.wav ErrorOccurred.wav |
| DSM driver face function activated  | Activate driver identification | FaceDetReminder.wav |
| Intercom mode  | Voice intercom mode | call_mode.wav |
| Intercom function reception  | Request voice intercom | call_req.wav |
| Intercom function initiation| Voice intercom in progress | call_ing.wav |
| Intercom function disconnected | Exit the voice intercom | call_stop.wav |
|PTT cluster mode |  PTT voice mode |ptt_mode.wav |
| PTT cluster initiated  | di | ptt_talk_ok.wav |
|gsensor dynamic calibration successful|Gravity induction calibration successful|GSensorMotionOk.wav |
|gsensor dynamic reset is complete |The gravity induction reset is complete|GSensorResetOk.wav |
|gsensor static calibration successful| Gravity induction calibration complete| GSensorSilenceOk.wav |
|gsensor rollover detection  | Rollover warning | Rollover.wav |
| gsensor sudden braking detection  | Brake alarm | HarshBraking.wav |
| gsensor rapid acceleration detection  | Rapid acceleration alarm | HarshAcceleration.wav |
|gsensor left sharp turn detection | Sharp left turn warning | LeftHarshCornering.wav |
|gsensor sharp right turn detection | Sharp Right turn warning | RightHarshCornering.wav |
| ~~GPS location failure (not used)~~  |~~GPS location failure~~ | ~~GPSInvalid.wav~~ |
| ~~GPS positioning successful (not used~~) | ~~GPS positioning successful~~ | ~~GPSValid.wav~~ |
| Too high temperature detection | Too high temperature | TemperatureHight.wav |
| Too low temperature detection  | Too low temperature | TemperatureLow.wav |
|Normal temperature detection | Normal temperature | TemperatureNormal.wav |
|~~Collision alarm (not used)~~  | ~~Front collision~~ | ~~FrontImpacted.wav~~ |
| ~~Rear-end collision alarm (not used)~~ | ~~Rear-end collision~~ | ~~RearImpacted.wav~~ |
|~~Left side collision alarm (not used)~~ | ~~Left side collision~~ | ~~LeftImpacted.wav~~ |
| ~~Right collision alarm (not used)~~ | ~~Right side collision~~ | ~~RightImpacted.wav~~ |



#### 2. Submit the WAV sound file to our technology to complete the final step of production.
